exercises.passage: When Maya walked to school, she always saw plastic bottles on the ground near the park. One day she decided to do something. She put a big box at the school gate with a sign: "Bring your bottles here!" At first only a few students used it. Then Maya had a better idea. She made a competition between the classes: the class that collected the most bottles would win a pizza party. In one month the students collected more than three thousand bottles. A recycling company took them and turned the plastic into new things, like benches. The mayor heard about the project and visited the school. Now there is a new green bench in the park, made from the students' bottles. "It started with one box," Maya says. "You don't have to be famous to change something."
exercises.question: What did Maya see near the park?
exercises.explain_he: כתוב: she always saw plastic bottles on the ground near the park.
